entries.en: The chemist included the ethyl radical in the proposed reaction mechanism.
entries.zh: 化学家在提出的反应机理中列入了乙自由基。

entries.en: The collection contained a sealed jar of eucalyptus gum from the old workshop.
entries.zh: 这批藏品中有一罐来自旧工坊的密封桉树胶。

entries.en: The conservator found eucalyptus kino in the workshop's historical materials list.
entries.zh: 文物修复师在工坊的历史材料清单中发现了桉胶。

entries.en: The laboratory compared eucalyptus oil samples from two suppliers.
entries.zh: 实验室比较了两家供应商提供的桉叶油样品。

entries.en: The metallurgist examined the structure of the eutectoid steel specimen.
entries.zh: 冶金学家检查了共析钢试样的组织结构。

entries.en: The exhibit compared the footprint of an even-toed ungulate with that of a horse.
entries.zh: 展览对比了一只偶蹄类动物和一匹马的足迹。

entries.en: The evergreen magnolia shaded the terrace throughout the year.
entries.zh: 荷花玉兰一年四季都为露台遮阴。
